interpretation: A polynomial-sized isotropic pool of syndrome-zero directions gives exact low-rank heat-bath kernels.  The audit separates the absolute gap from the integrated autocorrelation of the actual Walsh-Hessian observables and certifies the latter by a reversible lifting-detail decomposition.  Rank-two and rank-three blocks test whether locally coupled details cross barriers that freeze individual lines.  The dense-self-dual overlap calculation shows why this finite gain cannot be promoted to a worst-case 2^o(n) constant-rank theorem.
